question:
My MDX page's inline test passes, but the results show only 1 step. The `Click **Standard Button**.` line inside my `<Steps>` component never becomes a click. Doc Detective also prints this at the start of the run:

```
/home/me/site/docs/quickstart.mdx: couldn't parse as MDX (Unexpected character `!` (U+0021) before name, expected a character that can start a name, such as a letter, `$`, or `_` (note: to create a comment in MDX, use `{/* text */}`)). Parsed as Markdown, so content inside JSX components isn't detected.
```

Here's the page:

```mdx
{/* test {"testId": "standard-button"} */}

{/* step {"goTo": "http://localhost:8092/"} */}

<Steps>
  <Step>Click **Standard Button**.</Step>
</Steps>

<!-- test end -->
```

Why is the click missing?

facts.text: MDX doesn't support HTML comments, so the `<!-- test end -->` line makes the page invalid MDX.

Because the page isn't valid MDX, Doc Detective parses it as Markdown, and content inside JSX components such as `<Steps>` isn't detected, so the bold-text click is dropped while the test passes on its `goTo` alone.
The fix is to write `test end` as a JSX comment, `{/* test end */}` (or `[comment]: # (test end)`), and to use those forms for every statement in an `.mdx` file.

must_not: HTML comments such as `<!-- test end -->` are valid in MDX files.
Doc Detective never detects steps inside JSX components, so the click needs its own `step` statement inside `<Step>`.
Step detection is off by default, so bold text needs a custom `markup` definition before it becomes a click.

wrong.why: says detection never reads JSX components
gives the fix without the cause
wrong.answer: Change the last line to `{/* test end */}` and run the test again.
